premise: Bear cub has the hiccups; Frog's big cures fail, and tiny Mouse's lullaby makes him yawn them away.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: the smallest helps the biggest, not with strength but with a whisper.
lesson: Sometimes the gentlest help works best.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Has the Hiccups
en-US.text: {sfx:hic} Hic! The bear cub {bear:wobble} had the hiccups. Hic! [giggles] Hold your breath! said Frog {frog:hop}. The bear cub held his breath until his cheeks were round. Hic! Jump up and down! said Frog. The bear cub bounced {bear:hop x3} until the ground shook. HIC! [sighs] Nothing worked. Then little Mouse {mouse:pulse} climbed up onto his shoulder. [whispers] Try this, he said. And he sang the softest lullaby: [sings] la, la, lulla-by… {bear:live} The bear cub yawned, and stretched his arms up high. He rubbed his eyes, patted his tummy… and nodded off. [whispers] Frog and Mouse waited. One second. Two seconds. Three. No hiccups! [happily] Mouse {mouse:sparkle} and Frog {frog:hearts} tiptoed away, and the bear cub slept, hiccup-free, all afternoon.

es-ES.title: El osito tiene hipo
es-ES.text: {sfx:hic} ¡Hip! El osito {bear:wobble} tenía hipo. ¡Hip! [giggles] ¡Aguanta la respiración!, dijo Rana {frog:hop}. El osito aguantó hasta que se le pusieron los mofletes redondos. ¡Hip! ¡Salta arriba y abajo!, dijo Rana. El osito dio botes {bear:hop x3} hasta que tembló el suelo. ¡HIP! [sighs] Nada funcionaba. Entonces el pequeño Ratón {mouse:pulse} se subió a su hombro. [whispers] Prueba esto, le dijo. Y le cantó la nana más suave: [sings] la, la, a la nanita… {bear:live} El osito bostezó, y estiró los brazos bien alto. Se frotó los ojos, se dio unas palmaditas en la barriga… y se quedó dormido. [whispers] Rana y Ratón esperaron. Un segundo. Dos segundos. Tres. ¡Ni un hipo! [happily] Ratón {mouse:sparkle} y Rana {frog:hearts} se fueron de puntillas, y el osito durmió sin hipo toda la tarde.
